detail: MapWorldBuilderTests (or the sweep test added by lane/maps-sweep) loads all 415 native map-v1 documents with the full corpus bundle and pushed the sim suite from ~2.5 to ~8.5 minutes. Keep it, but skip unless OPENBFME_SLOW_TESTS=1 (print the reason), and run it nightly. Same treatment for any test over 60 s: list them with `dotnet test --logger console;verbosity=normal` durations in the report. Also gate AiSweepTests (lane kernel-g extended it to every ordered faction matchup) and AiRetailProofTests; on a loaded machine the Debug sim suite now runs past 10 minutes.
oracle: dotnet test engine/OpenBfme.Engine.sln --nologo   # under 3 minutes wall clock without OPENBFME_SLOW_TESTS; with it set, the map sweep test runs and passes
title: Gate the load-every-map corpus test behind OPENBFME_SLOW_TESTS so the engine suite stays under 3 minutes
